original_prompt: A pat of butter in a warm pan softens, loses its sharp edges, and spreads into a liquid pool.

initial_condition.description: The visibly heated pan supplies the heat that softens and melts the butter.

pre_event_image_prompt: A realistic fixed close photograph of one firm rectangular pat of pale-yellow butter at the center of one clean stainless-steel pan. The butter has straight sides and sharp edges, with no liquid pool yet. Gentle heat shimmer and warm reflections on the pan make the heating condition clear while the initial butter remains solid. Show the entire pan center with open room for the material to spread. One continuous 1280x704 landscape frame.
text_policy: pre_event_image_prompt is used verbatim for image generation
